subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252 to be rebased and made editable, or replace/adopt it with a maintainer-owned narrow fix?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but the live implementation candidate is outside the target repo, conflicting, and not maintainer-modifiable.

options.title: Replace or adopt in target repo
options.body: Open a narrow target-repo fix or adopt the fork patch with credit, then close the fork PR only after the replacement path exists.

options.title: Ask for contributor rebase
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it onto current main and enable maintainer edits if possible.

options.title: Wait without action
options.body: Leave the source-reproducible UI/TUI rendering bug open while the conflicting fork PR remains idle.

recommendation.title: Replace or adopt in target repo
recommendation.body: Open a narrow target-repo fix or adopt the fork patch with credit, then close the fork PR only after the replacement path exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They are strongly connected to the shared inbound metadata sanitizer and TUI display cleanup boundary that needs the fix.
